stem: Two workers perform the same task in the same room. One is wearing additional chemical-resistant protective clothing. Why might their heat risk differ?
choices: Protective clothing can add heat burden and reduce heat loss
Heat risk depends only on room temperature
Protective clothing always cools the worker
Heat risk is identical whenever the task is identical
rationale: Workload, environmental conditions and clothing all affect heat strain. Additional protective clothing can increase the worker's heat burden.
